params.text: The level it clips at, in decibels; 0dB is the output of a standard oscillator. CV alongside
Amplifies after the clipping; CV alongside
A softer or harder transition as the signal crosses the threshold

inputs.text: The left signal in; the channels patched here set the polyphony
0-10V scaling the threshold knob's position, which puts the threshold at -24dB at 0V
A CV added to the output gain, 5V either way

outputs.text: That side's signal after the clipper and the output gain; it soft-clips at 12V

notes: it chops the signal at the voltage matching the threshold, which distorts it heavily. LMTR does the same job by reducing the level instead, and distorts far less
the clipper reads the left and right inputs summed, so both sides clip together
